project.name: JToolsFramework dist
project.description: What the distributions of a project are made of: build.xml — the modules the program needs (jdeps), a runtime per platform trimmed to them (jlink), the Linux and macOS tar.gz and the Windows zip, and the launchers and .ini they carry, written for any program by the jtools.app.* properties. The parent's dist profile unpacks it; nothing here runs.
